verified_technical_projects.name: Neural Process Twin
substantiated_facts: Constructed physics-aware deep learning surrogate models in PyTorch for 2D steady-state heat conduction.
Demonstrated orders-of-magnitude faster inference speedup compared to standard finite-difference solvers.
Maintained physical consistency and quantified predictive uncertainty across parameter spaces.

verified_technical_projects.name: LLM Inference Intelligence Engine
substantiated_facts: Built measurement-driven benchmarking suite profiling hardware ceilings across CPU and GPU topologies.
Instrumented TTFT (prefill latency) and TPOT (decode throughput) under dynamic batching loads.
Implemented Roofline model diagnostics isolating memory-bandwidth saturation versus compute bounds.

verified_technical_projects.name: PINN Residual Defect Solvers & Error Estimation
substantiated_facts: Independently audited and reproduced Krasowski et al. (arXiv:2603.15526) residual-based error estimation methodology.
Extended methodology to soft boundary constraints, rigorously validating defect propagation without analytical solutions.

verified_technical_projects.name: C++17 Peng-Robinson Real-Gas Cubic EOS Engine
substantiated_facts: Developed modern C++17 Peng-Robinson cubic equation of state solver with analytic derivatives (dP/dv)_T.
Classified thermodynamic mechanical stability and evaluated enthalpy, entropy, and fugacity departures.

verified_technical_projects.name: Multi-DOF Servo Kinematics & Embedded Microcontroller Loops
substantiated_facts: Designed and assembled multi-DOF servo-actuated kinematic mechanisms with low-latency control loops.
Implemented sensor telemetry and positional feedback algorithms for closed-loop physical coordination.

verified_technical_projects.name: Students-Undergraduate Research Graduate Excellence (SuRGE) — Microdrone Autonomy
substantiated_facts: Selected for IIT Delhi SuRGE programme under Prof. Amartansh Dubey (Electrical Engineering).
Investigated 3D environment mapping, trajectory tracking, and autonomous path following for microdrones.
Studied state estimation, navigation, and control under limited sensing and uncertainty.

verified_technical_projects.name: OPVI Opportunity Intelligence Platform
substantiated_facts: Designed and independently built a full-stack MVP for discovering and tracking research internships and competitions.
Engineered deadline-aware follow-up workflows, personalized filtering, and persistent state management.

verified_technical_projects.name: Sovereign On-Premise Agentic AI Workbench (MRPL, SIH 2026)
substantiated_facts: Led system architecture across 6-person team for confidential industrial AI workflows using open-weight multimodal LLMs.
Designed orchestration, authentication/security boundaries, tool sandboxing, and sensitive data access controls.
